en.heroLead: Hems, fittings, dress alterations, mending and repairs at Coit & Parker in Plano. A neighborhood tailor since 2007, with regulars who've trusted us for years.
en.svcTitle: Every piece cut to fit you
en.svcLead: Bring in anything that's too long, too loose, too tight or torn. We'll measure, pin and make it right.
en.s1p: Pants, jeans, skirts and dresses taken up to exactly the right length.
en.s2p: Taking in, letting out and reshaping so your clothes fit the way they should.
en.s3p: Everyday and special-occasion dresses, including bridesmaid dresses, fitted to you.
en.s4p: Rips, split seams and worn spots repaired so you can keep wearing what you love.
en.s5p: Shirts, jackets and jeans adjusted for daily wear, done carefully and on time.
en.s6p: Regulars bring us dozens of garments over the years. Bring the whole pile.
en.l1: Customers who've brought every alteration here for 8+ years
en.l2: Dresses fixed when others weren't sure they could be
en.l3: Work finished on time, sometimes ahead of schedule
en.callSub: Call with questions or for a quote
en.a1: Stop by during shop hours with your clothes. For a bigger job, call ahead at (972) 599-1595.
en.q2: What should I bring to a fitting?
en.a2: Bring the shoes and undergarments you'll wear with the piece, so the length and fit come out exactly right.
en.q3: Can you alter a dress for a wedding or event?
en.a3: Yes, including bridesmaid and special-occasion dresses. Come in early so there's time for a second fitting.
en.title: Parker Tailor | Alterations at Coit & Parker, Plano
en.desc: Clothing alterations, hemming, dress fittings, mending and repair at Parker Tailor, 3304 Coit Rd, Plano, TX 75023. Serving Plano since 2007. Rated 4.7 on Google. Call (972) 599-1595.
